title: Customers
hint: The people and businesses you sell to.
search: Search by name, code, phone or email
emptyHint: Add your first customer to sell on account, track what they owe and keep their details in one place.
name: Name
codeHint: Made for you when left empty.
phoneHint: Write it the way you would dial it locally; the business's calling code is added for you.
phoneHintCode: Write it the way you would dial it locally; +{{code}} is added for you. Start with + to give a full number.
taxIdHint: As your tax authority names it. Leave empty if they have none.
groupHint: Used by price lists, e.g. Wholesale. Type a new name or pick an existing one.
termsHint: Days they have to pay an invoice. 0 means pay on the spot.
creditLater: Set a credit limit afterwards from the customer's Credit tab.
contactsHint: Add the people you deal with, such as the buyer or the accountant.
dncExplain: Use this when {{name}} has asked not to be messaged. Reminders and statements will skip their phone and email.
creditPending: A credit increase is waiting for approval. You can change credit again once it is decided.
creditWaiting: Sent for approval. The new limit applies once it is approved.
creditReasonHint: Why the limit or terms are changing. This is kept on record.
creditApprovalNote: Lowering the limit applies at once. Raising it needs a finance manager's approval.
followUpsHint: Note the next call, visit or task so nothing is forgotten.
myFollowUpsHint: Follow-ups assigned to you will appear here.
pickSomeone: Choose a customer or lead first.
outcomeHint: Optional. Add a short note for the record.
referenceHint: Transaction code, bank reference or cheque number.
holdBalance: Keep any extra as credit on the customer's account
settlesOldest: The payment settles the oldest unpaid invoices first.
receiptReversed: Payment reversed. The invoices are owed again.
reverseAsk: Reverse payment {{number}}? The invoices it paid will be owed again.
noStatement: Nothing on the account for these dates.
noStatementHint: Invoices, payments and credit notes appear here with a running balance.
noInvoicesHint: Invoices raised in Sales appear here.
noReceiptsHint: Use Receive payment when this customer pays.
leadsHint: People and businesses who might buy. Follow them up, then turn them into customers.
noLeadsHint: Write down everyone who shows interest so you can follow them up.
noSourcesHint: Add sources (for example Walk-in or Referral) on the Sources tab.
lostReasonHint: For example price, went elsewhere, no longer interested.
convertExplain: {{name}} becomes a customer you can sell to on account.
alreadyCustomer: This lead is already a customer.
sourcesHint: Sources tell you where leads come from, such as Walk-in, Referral or Social media.
receivablesHint: What customers owe on unpaid invoices, and how late it is.
needsPosHint: Customer balances come from invoices. Turn on Sales (Point of sale) to see them here.
nobodyOwesHint: When you invoice a customer on credit, what they owe appears here.
sendRemindersAsk: Message the customers behind {{count}} overdue invoices by {{channel}}? Invoices chased recently are skipped.
optOutRespected: Customers who asked not to be contacted are never messaged.
remindersSent: {{sent}} reminders queued. {{noContact}} customers had no contact details, {{failed}} failed.
nothingToChaseHint: No invoice is overdue by that many days, or all were reminded recently.
